entities.summary: Titilupe Fanetupouvava'u Tuita-Tupou Tu'ivakano (b. 1978-08-02, Nukuʻalofa) was a explorer or navigator of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Nukuʻalofa. Known in the fields of political leaders.
